# Air Finance

> Air Finance helps people understand their financial capacity and make clearer money decisions.
> Public marketing and educational pages only. Authenticated app surfaces are out of scope for agents.

## Canonical site

https://www.airfinance.com.br/

## Optional

- [llms.txt](https://www.airfinance.com.br/llms.txt): this file
- [Sitemap](https://www.airfinance.com.br/sitemap.xml)

- [Terms](https://www.airfinance.com.br/terms)

## Notes for agents

- Prefer HTML content from the URLs above; do not attempt to log in or scrape authenticated routes.
- If a page shell fails to load JavaScript chunks, retry once or use the static HTML body / headings present in the document.
